messages:
Ravi (People Ops): FYI @channel we're launching 'evidence intake v2' today to support accelerated attestation lanes for SOC2/ISO. Goal: make uploads faster and reduce back-and-forth with auditors. Please read the short runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/compliance/intake-v2. Deadline for the first wave (all evidence leads nominated + initial artifacts uploaded): Fri May 12 COB.

Lina (Eng): Quick clarifying q 020 000000 can a team nominate more than one evidence lead?

Ravi (People Ops): Yep, you can have a primary and a backup. Primary will be the one auditors ask for, backup is good for coverage. Use the nomination form on the runbook.

Omar (Security): A few security notes for intake v2: 1) evidence uploads land in an encrypted S3 bucket with restricted ACLs; 2) if you're uploading logs, strip session tokens and secret IDs before upload (see redaction guidance); 3) the intake tool will run a lightweight scan and flag obvious PII or secrets.

qa-bot: Automated scan report will be attached to the team's intake page after upload. Expect ~2-5 minute processing time per artifact.

Priya (Legal): Addendum from legal: include contractors and vendor access logs for the last 90 days unless you have a documented vendor exclusion. If an artifact contains customer data, follow the special redaction flow -- DM me if you need an exception.

Ravi (People Ops): We're also introducing small "lane types" so auditors can sample efficiently: 

```
- infra-lane: VPC configs, firewall rules, access control lists
- app-lane: service runbooks, deployment approvals, change logs
- data-lane: data retention policy, DB access lists, anonymization reports
```

Lina (Eng): For infra-lane, is a single snapshot of ACLs + one month of audit logs enough?

Omar (Security): For most controls, auditors want at least 2 months of logs, but the intake checklist will indicate required window per control. If you only have 1 month, mark it and explain why in the intake note.

Ravi (People Ops): We're running three 30-min office hours next week focused on nomination + upload help: Tue 11:00 PT, Wed 16:00 PT, Thu 09:00 PT. I'll post calendar invites. If your team needs a dedicated 15-min walkthrough, book time on my calendar. :calendar: :clock1:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 00: nominations due in 7 days. Additional auto-reminders at 72h and 24h.

Lina (Eng): Nomination submitted (primary: Kumi, backup: Javier). Uploaded initial runbook + deployment approval screenshot.

Ravi (People Ops): Awesome 10 Thanks Kumi/Javier. Small filename tip from security: include control and generation date in the filename, e.g., infra-vpc-acls-20260501.json. Makes auditor sampling much easier.

Priya (Legal): Also remember to complete the annual privacy recert by May 20 if you haven't already  this is separate from intake but often shows up during audits.

Lina (Eng): Noted  will nudging the team.

Ravi (People Ops): Final note: if your team is blocked by access to any internal systems needed for evidence export, file the 'evidence access' ticket in JIRA and tag @people-ops so we can escalate. We'll publish the consolidated list of nominated leads on Friday afternoon. :thumbsup:

Lina (Eng): Thanks all, appreciate the streamlined flow.
